description: Keep a case run's save and Chough's own Git under the FLOW-14 stop watch (issue 75, review on #79)
no_spec_change_rationale: Call-site wiring for REQ-cli-011 as widened by stop-what-chough-started-when-chough-is-stopped-issue-75: cases.rs holds the stop watch through the save and evidence.rs runs Git through records::run_owned. The requirement text lives in that change.
